description:
A saint of calligraphy and painting who has reached divine heights! From the prestigious Yemunsegae family of Hoseo, Sogaju Lee Gun-Ak has been called a prodigy since childhood. Born into a family, Gun-Ak is caught up in the conflict between the seven great clans of the Central Plains and, as a descendant of Hwaseong, demonstrates mystical calligraphy. Mysterious pursuers of unknown origins gradually approach, and he experiences the tragic murder of his father...

The life of Shin Pil-Hwa, a divine calligrapher who captures the world in his paintings!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
